beats.summary: Michael grabs attention with 'SEX' and 'MONEY' before Ryan presents the WUPHF investment opportunity.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Excuse me, everyone… SEX! Now that I have your attention…

beats.summary: Ryan reveals WUPHF has only nine days of funding left and opens a second round of investment.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: We have nine solid days.
Ryan: So I've decided to open up a second round of investment to friends and family.

beats.summary: Some employees express skepticism about WUPHF's financial viability and urge selling the company.

evidence.snippet: Stanley: I want my money back.

beats.summary: Ryan pitches creative marketing ideas including WUPHF T-shirts and a helicopter dropping condoms.

evidence.snippet: Ryan: WUPHF T-Shirts. Who wants one?
